entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number? And just to confirm, you're calling about the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor?
Yes. The name is Sam Jones, order 772-B. The thing is garbage.

Okay, I have your order pulled up. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't track my heart rate correctly. It's useless. I don't have time to figure it out, I just want my money back.
I understand. A faulty device can be very frustrating. I can definitely look into a refund for you. To verify a defect, I just need to walk you through a quick reset. It only takes about a minute.
No. I'm not doing that. I'm not technical support. I want a refund, that's it.
I see. Well, let me just check the policy for your item... One moment please.
Okay, thanks for your patience, Sam. I see here that you received the item 9 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.

Since you are well within that 90-day window, I've gone ahead and approved your return. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll see the refund processed once we receive it.
Fine. Whatever. It shouldn't have been that difficult.
I apologize for any inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a nice day.
